wallpapers.name: Fujiyama Dawn
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.tagline: A sacred mountain at first light
wallpapers.description: A cinematic Japanese landscape: a snow-capped volcano rising above a mirror lake, a vermilion gate in the shallows, a five-storey pagoda among blossoming cherry trees, drifting clouds, low mist and petals carried by the wind.

wallpapers.name: Neon Rain
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.tagline: A city that never powers down
wallpapers.description: A rain-soaked future metropolis: towering blocks studded with lit windows, flickering neon signage, mirror-wet streets, ground traffic and hover-car lanes, drifting fog and rotating holograms.

wallpapers.name: Deep Space
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.tagline: Drift beyond the edge of the map
wallpapers.description: A slow orbit through an uncharted system: a banded ringed giant, its cratered moon, a living nebula, a tumbling asteroid belt and a sky of twinkling stars.

wallpapers.name: Monolith
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: Floating geometric sculptures in polished chrome, brushed gold and smoked glass orbit a morphing liquid core above a black mirror floor, lit by slow-moving cold lights.

wallpapers.name: Stadium Night
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.tagline: Floodlights, flashes and a full house
wallpapers.description: A night match atmosphere inside an original stadium design: three tiers of animated supporters with a stadium wave, floodlight beams cutting through the haze, camera flashes and drifting confetti as the camera circles the pitch. Unofficial artistic interpretation — not affiliated with any club or venue.

wallpapers.name: Code Rain
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.tagline: Endless code falling through the dark
wallpapers.description: Columns of glowing glyphs and code symbols fall through a deep 3D volume. Layers fade into fog while the camera drifts slowly between the streams.

wallpapers.name: Neural Mind
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.tagline: A thinking network made of light
wallpapers.description: Thousands of neurons arranged in two hemispheres fire signals along their synapses inside a holographic shell, circled by orbital data rings.

wallpapers.name: Event Horizon
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.tagline: Light bending around a black hole
wallpapers.description: A ray-marched black hole: starlight bends around the event horizon and the glowing accretion disk is lensed above and below it, brighter on the side spinning towards you.

wallpapers.name: Open Ocean
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: An open sea simulated with layered Gerstner waves: foam forms on the crests, light glows through the thin water, and the sun glitters across the surface.

wallpapers.name: Luxury Garage
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.tagline: A grand tourer under studio light
wallpapers.description: An original grand-tourer design turns slowly on a lit turntable in a dark showroom. Light strips glide across the clear-coat and reflect in the black mirror floor. Original design — not a replica of any manufacturer’s model.

wallpapers.name: Golden Khatam
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: Layers of interlaced eight-point stars, inspired by traditional Arabic geometric art, turn slowly in warm light beneath pointed arches while dust drifts through the hall.

wallpapers.name: Cyber Network
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A dark procedural Earth with glowing city grids and an atmosphere. Data packets race along arcs between cities while a satellite ring circles overhead.

wallpapers.name: The Walk Out
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: Walk down the players’ tunnel towards the floodlit pitch: concrete walls, light strips, haze rolling in the beams and the roar of the stadium glowing at the end. Unofficial artistic interpretation.

wallpapers.name: Trophy Room
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: An original championship cup turns slowly on a black plinth while spotlights sweep across it, surrounded by illuminated glass cabinets and drifting golden sparkles.

wallpapers.name: Rain Match
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.tagline: A match ball in the downpour
wallpapers.description: A close-up of a match ball on a soaked pitch under floodlights: rain streaks, splashes and ripples on the wet grass, stadium lights glowing through the storm.

wallpapers.name: Terminal
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.tagline: Live shell sessions in the dark
wallpapers.description: Floating terminal windows type out real-looking sessions — git, ssh, docker, kubectl, Python training runs and SQL — with scanlines and the odd glitch.

wallpapers.name: Code Universe
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.tagline: Fly through a galaxy of source code
wallpapers.description: Thousands of lines of real TypeScript, Python, C#, C++, SQL and shell drift through deep space in blue, violet and cyan as the camera flies endlessly forward.

wallpapers.name: Firewall
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A vast hexagonal energy barrier seen from inside the network. Hostile packets stream in and burst against it, sending ripples of light across the shield.

wallpapers.name: Planet Earth
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.tagline: Day turns to night below you
wallpapers.description: A procedural Earth seen from orbit: oceans and continents, ice caps, moving clouds, sun glinting on the sea and city lights sparkling across the night side, wrapped in a blue atmosphere.

wallpapers.name: Northern Lights
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: Curtains of aurora ripple across a starry arctic sky above snowy peaks, mirrored in a still lake.

wallpapers.name: Midnight Highway
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A chase camera follows an original sports car down an endless motorway at night, weaving past traffic under sodium street lights with the city skyline on the horizon. Original car design.

wallpapers.name: Neon DNA
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A glowing double helix with base-pair rungs turns slowly in a dark void while energy pulses run along its strands.

wallpapers.name: Bamboo Forest
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: Walk a stone path through towering bamboo swaying in the wind, with sunbeams through the canopy, soft fog and falling leaves.

wallpapers.name: Mechanical Watch
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: An open-heart skeleton watch that shows the real time: meshing gears, a beating balance wheel, ruby jewels and polished metal under studio light.

wallpapers.name: Olive Grove
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: Ancient olive trees on stone terraces in the hills at golden hour, their silver-green leaves moving in the wind as dust drifts through the light.

wallpapers.name: Floating Islands
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: Grassy islands of rock drift above a sea of clouds, waterfalls pouring from their edges, a ruined tower on the largest, birds circling.

wallpapers.name: RGB Setup
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A dark gaming desk: a mechanical keyboard rippling with RGB waves, a curved monitor full of code, a glass PC with spinning lit fans and LED strips.

wallpapers.name: Sky City
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: Glass megatowers rise above a sea of clouds at sunset, linked by skybridges, with air traffic gliding along orbital lanes.

wallpapers.name: Ringed Giant
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.tagline: A gas giant and its rings
wallpapers.description: A banded gas giant with a vast ring system lit by a distant sun. The planet casts its shadow across the rings while a small moon circles slowly.

wallpapers.name: Coral Depths
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A sunlit coral reef seen from under the surface: caustics ripple over the sand, light shafts sway through the water, schools of fish circle the reef and bubbles rise.

wallpapers.name: Arcane Portal
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: An ancient ring of carved stone on a ruined plateau at night. A swirling vortex fills it, glowing runes orbit the ring and rocks float into the starry sky.

wallpapers.name: Liquid Chrome
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A mirror-finish blob of molten metal floats above a dark studio floor, its surface rippling and folding, reflecting softbox and coloured rim lights.

wallpapers.name: Server Room
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A long cold aisle between rows of server racks. Thousands of status LEDs blink with activity, light strips run along the ceiling and the camera glides down the aisle.

wallpapers.name: Language Worlds
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: The name of your programming language glows as a hologram above a grid floor while panels of real code in that language orbit around it. Choose Python, C#, TypeScript, C++, SQL or Linux shell — each with its own colours.

wallpapers.name: Silicon Core
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A slow macro flight over a processor die: a grid of cores glowing with their own load, copper traces between them and pulses of light racing from core to core.

wallpapers.name: Security Core
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: An encrypted energy core shielded by counter-rotating rings of hexagonal plates. Threats approach from every side and burst against the outer ring while a scan beam sweeps around the core.

wallpapers.name: Cyber Glitch
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A neon sculpture caught in a corrupted signal: slices tear sideways, colour channels split and blocks of digital noise flicker across a scanline backdrop in short, violent bursts.

wallpapers.name: Data Tunnel
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: An endless flight through a bending tunnel built from streams of binary and hex. Columns of data scroll along the walls and rings of light rush past.

wallpapers.name: Dev Desk
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A developer's desk late at night: two monitors scroll real code, the keyboard glows with your typing rhythm, steam rises from a mug and rain runs down the window over the city. Switch between a neon hacker room and a warm, cosy study.

wallpapers.name: AI Brain
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A holographic brain made of tens of thousands of points floats above a lab platform. Waves of thought ripple through it, synapses spark across its surface and data streams flow up into it.

wallpapers.name: Robotic Hand
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A precise robotic hand with ceramic plates and lit joints reaches towards a floating orb of data; as the fingertip closes in, an arc of energy jumps across the gap.

wallpapers.name: Command Center
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A curved wall of holographic panels in a dark operations room: a radar sweep, live traffic graphs, a world map with connection arcs, system gauges and a scrolling event log, all animated.

wallpapers.name: Quantum Computer
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: The golden chandelier of a quantum computer's dilution refrigerator hangs in a dark lab: stacked gold plates linked by coiled lines, cooling stage by stage down to a glowing chip where qubits flicker between states.

wallpapers.name: Git Galaxy
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A repository's history grows in space: the main branch winds forward, feature branches fork off in their own colours, collect commits and merge back, while the camera rides along the newest commit.

wallpapers.name: Nebula Voyage
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.tagline: Into the heart of a nebula
wallpapers.description: Drift through a vast emission nebula: billowing glowing gas in several colours cut by dark dust lanes, young stars shining inside and star dust streaming past.

wallpapers.name: Stone Village
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: An old village of limestone houses with arched windows and domes climbs a terraced hill among olive and cypress trees. At sunset the stone glows gold; at night the windows light up like oil lamps.

wallpapers.name: Sakura Night
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A temple garden under a full moon: a great cherry tree in full bloom leans over a still pond, stone lanterns glow along the path, a red arched bridge crosses the water and petals drift down.

wallpapers.name: Controller Arena
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: An original game controller floats above a neon hex arena. Its buttons and light bar pulse to a beat, energy pillars rise around the arena and a ring of light sweeps across the floor on every beat.

wallpapers.name: Black Marble
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A still life of polished black marble with veins of gold: a slab and plinths hold a slowly turning metal ring and sphere while soft light glides across the stone so the veins shimmer.

wallpapers.name: Tunnel Run
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A sports car tears through a long concrete tunnel at night. Ceiling light strips streak past overhead, their reflections slide across the wet road and the camera chases low behind the car.

wallpapers.name: Crystal Cavern
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A vast cave lit only by giant crystals growing from its floor, walls and ceiling. Their light pulses slowly, reflects in a dark underground pool and catches on drifting dust.

wallpapers.name: Sky Traffic
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A megacity at night seen from high above a canyon of towers. Streams of flying cars follow layered air lanes between the buildings — white headlights one way, red tail lights the other.

wallpapers.name: Thunderstorm
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A supercell rolls over open plains at dusk: the cloud base churns overhead, rain sweeps across the fields and branching lightning lights the clouds from inside before striking the ground. Optional rain sound.

wallpapers.name: Waterfall
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A tall waterfall pours from a mossy cliff into a jungle pool: the water streams and foams, spray drifts up from the plunge, ripples spread across the pool and a faint rainbow hangs in the mist. Optional water sound.

wallpapers.name: Tatreez
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: Palestinian cross-stitch embroidery: eight-pointed stars, cypress trees, diamonds and zig-zag borders, drawn stitch by stitch, ripple gently like fabric in a breeze under warm light.

wallpapers.name: Floating Spheres
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A calm, minimal composition: soft matte, satin and chrome spheres drift slowly in front of a seamless studio backdrop, their soft shadows sliding across the floor.

wallpapers.name: Golden Ball
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A golden football with classic hexagon and pentagon panels rests on a marble pedestal in a dark arena while spotlights cut through the haze and confetti falls.

wallpapers.name: Torii Path
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.tagline: A thousand gates up the mountain
wallpapers.description: A tunnel of vermilion torii gates climbs a forested mountain path. Paper lanterns glow between the gates, mist drifts through and you walk slowly up the path — at night, at dusk or in falling snow.

wallpapers.name: Synthwave
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: An endless 1980s neon drive: a striped sun sinks behind wireframe mountains, the grid floor rushes towards you and stars twinkle in a purple sky.

wallpapers.name: Enchanted Forest
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A deep forest at night: clusters of glowing mushrooms light the mossy ground, fireflies wander between ancient trunks and a beam of moonlight falls through a gap in the canopy.

wallpapers.name: Clockwork
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: The heart of a mechanical movement: brass and steel gears of every size mesh and turn at their true ratios, a balance wheel swings back and forth and jewels glint between the plates.

wallpapers.name: Orbital Station
wallpapers.author: Awajeh
wallpapers.description: A ring-shaped space station turns slowly above the curve of the Earth: its windows glow, solar arrays catch the sun, a shuttle glides in to dock and the planet's clouds drift by far below.
